item.title: Update: Katsuhiro Harada shares New Year's messages on the future as his time with Tekken and Bandai Namco is now over
item.description: <p><strong>Update:</strong> Katsuhiro Harada has now shared a post confirming his time with the Tekken series has come to an end after 31 years.</p> <p>After decades under the same leadership, Tekken is now entering a brand new era moving into 2026.</p> <p>It appears that longtime Tekken Director Katsuhiro Harada is officially gone from Bandai Namco.</p>

item.title: New Virtua Fighter Project Producer says he thinks 2026 will be the time to fully unveil the game in New Year's message
item.description: <p>It's now been over <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2024/dec/12/virtua-fighter-announcement/">one year since the New Virtua Fighter Project was first revealed to the world</a>, but we've learned very little about the long-awaited title since.</p> <p>That may finally be changing in the new year, however.</p>

item.title: Fighting game-themed Happy New Year artwork released by Capcom, Bandai Namco, Arc System Works, SNK, SEGA and French Bread
item.description: <p>After a long year of successes and hardships in 2025, we've finally entered the new year of 2026 and who knows what's waiting for us on the horizon?</p> <p>As a celebration for the new year that is now upon us, several of the biggest fighting game developers have released special artwork and graphics to wish all of their fans a happy new year which we've compiled in this story.</p>

item.title: New teaser trailer for fan-made Sega vs. Capcom fighting game shows first gameplay of Vyse from Skies of Arcadia and Morrigan
item.description: <p>We recently reported on the newly announced fan-made game <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/29/capcom-square-fighting-game/">Capcom vs. Square: Parallel Destinies</a>, though fans who have been paying attention surely know that this isn't the first fan-made versus game involving Capcom characters we've talked about in recent years.</p> <p>It's been a few years now since we first heard about fan-made project Sega vs. Capcom: The Next Level and today, we have a new teaser trailer

item.title: Will Bandai Namco reveal all of Tekken 8's third season characters at once or keep their identities hidden as they've previously done?
item.description: <p>We're just about one month away from the Tekken World Tour Finals which will be taking place in Malmö, Sweden.</p> <p>While there's no guarantee that we'll see any Season 3 news at the event, it would be a prime opportunity for Bandai Namco and the Tekken team to unveil what's coming next, but one of the more important questions for fans since last year isn't so much when they'll bring new reveals — but how?</p>

item.title: Street Fighter 6 Director and Producer promise more updates and collaborations for 2026 in New Year's message
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> is trucking along in it's third year, but the game has been going through something of a content drought lately.</p> <p>The Street Fighter Director and Producer promise there is more to come for players here in 2026.</p>

item.title: 'Objective' 2XKO tier list released by Evo France finalist where the big bad wolf is placed higher than you probably expect
item.description: <p>We're now just around a month away from the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/11/2xko-announce/">Season 1 launch of 2XKO alongside Caitlyn and the console release</a>, but the game's community has already been going hard for quite a while already.</p> <p>One of France's best recently put together what he describes as "the most objective 2XKO tier list you've ever seen" following the previous balance update from the start of the month.</p>

item.title: There's a new roguelike fighting game coming that lets you steal your opponent's moves after beating them
item.description: <p>The fighting game genre is filled with all sorts of different titles with their own unique features and mechanics that make them stand out though we usually don't see ones like this.</p> <p>Developer HeartLoop Games is working on a new roguelike fighting game that's looking to take things in a different direction.</p>

item.title: Yugi's crazy Dragon Ball FighterZ mod is as complex as playing Yu-Gi-Oh itself, so the creator made a guide for his card mechanics
item.description: <p>One of the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/26/yugioh-dragon-ball-mod/">greatest fighting game mods we've ever seen recently dropped for Yami Yugi in Dragon Ball FighterZ</a>.</p> <p>The king of games in fighter form while being ridiculously and lovingly detailed is also pretty much as complex as trying to play actual Yu-Gi-Oh, but now there's an easy way to figure out what Pot of Greed does.</p>

item.title: Capcom hiring a new fighting game battle planner has some big implications for Street Fighter 6 or something new in the future
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> is still going strong in the middle of its third year already though there could be some interesting changes coming down the pipeline at some point.</p> <p>Capcom is now looking to hire a new fighting game developer, which has potentially big implications for Street Fighter and also maybe something else in the future.</p>
